root_cause: wide_step broadcasted the same K[step] once per SIMD group; multi-group blocks repeated the load and broadcast.
change: compute one vector K broadcast per step and reuse it across groups; enable the shared-K multi-group path for two or more groups on aarch64.
conclusion: The repaired path remains a stable 1.59x batch lead. This campaign does not isolate the K-sharing delta from the previous grouped campaign; no independent percentage improvement is claimed.
